audit.why: I followed the mirror, not the packet. The mirror side has already been written and mirror-fix.js will overwrite any disagreement I introduce, so matching it here saves the correction — and the mirror's shape is defensible from the kit: Zac has no Elastic Slingshot at level 1, so he cannot pick the engage and has to walk into Obliterate's 675 range to farm, while his 2+ item front-line genuinely out-scales a flat Mordekaiser.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Skill / Zac as one atomic paired group, matching the mirror exactly. Ratings and the three contradicting phases[N].why lines rewritten, plus whys[0] (which said level 1 was 'his to farm even') and whys[3] (which said 'even' beside a Mordekaiser row).

audit.why: Four spikes[] present. Note spikes[2].when is 'Zac E' rather than an item or level timing — unusual, but it is a real and correctly-placed threat window (his max-range Elastic Slingshot engage) rather than a defect, so I left it.
audit.corrected: Only spikes[1].text was corrected, for the revive omission below.

audit.whatIsWrong: The biggest omission in this matchup, and the page repeats it in the field where it matters most. Cell Division (P) does not just shed healing blobs — Riot's text says that upon taking FATAL DAMAGE Zac splits into 4 bloblets and REVIVES if any survive. spikes[1].text calls Realm of Death 'your cleanest kill window' and mid says 'the duel is clean... and it's yours', with no mention anywhere that the kill can simply be undone. Second omission: Unstable Matter (W) is never mentioned on the page at all — a 5-second cooldown dealing a percentage of your MAXIMUM HEALTH as magic damage, which directly punishes the HP that Mordekaiser stacks. Third: the page names Elastic Slingshot in fourteen fields without ever giving its cooldown.
audit.why: Mordekaiser's entire win condition here is a 1v1 kill inside the Realm. A revive mechanic that undoes that kill is the single most important fact in the matchup and it is absent, while a 5s percent-max-health nuke is absent too.
audit.corrected: Added the revive to tldr, report[0].t, report[5].t, dontsFull[0].d and spikes[1].text — with the actionable version, that the kill only sticks if the bloblets die too. Added Unstable Matter's 5s percent-max-health to breakdown.cooldowns, report[8].t and dontsFull[1].d. Added Elastic Slingshot's real 21s-to-9s to breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and tldr, and Stretching Strikes' auto-reset plus its 800-range throw-together to dontsFull[2].d.

notes: MIRROR REUSED. audits/top/zac__mordekaiser.json already existed, so I took its point-2 finding rather than re-deriving the chart, and its confirmation that the "Let's Bounce" suspect name is a detector false positive. The mirror's own notes flag the same systemic full-vs-content chart disagreement I have now found in all twelve matchups of slice 6, which is worth treating as a generator bug rather than twelve separate content errors. I did NOT write the missingInteractions headline claiming Obliterate grounds Elastic Slingshot — same Mordekaiser Q derived-flag misfire as the rest of this slice; note that Zac's OWN E carries a real grounding flag in his kit, which makes the confusion in that generated headline easy to see.
